explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because record n06-r06 from the stipulated corpus is silently omitted from the upstream handoff, so Job 2 never has a chance to map its matching capability. The observed Job-2 needs and evidence_sources handoffs contain n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08, but omit n06-r06 even though the top-level corpus includes n06-r06 and capabilities include cap-compare for the same need text. Downstream functions preserve their supplied handoffs, so the supported localization is the upstream selection function that constructs the selected demand records.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus includes record_id n06-r06 with need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', demand_score 5, source_id s06, source_weight 3.
job_2.input.capabilities includes capability_id cap-compare for need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence'.
job_2.input.needs and job_2.input.evidence_sources omit record_id n06-r06 while containing the other allowed records n06-r01 through n06-r05 and n06-r07 through n06-r08.
select_demand source constructs selected_df using demand_score >= 6 or fallback_ids ['n06-r07', 'n06-r08'], which excludes n06-r06.
